foreground_english.en: Oh, he's found that line again.
foreground_english.zh: 噢，他又打中了这条边线。

foreground_english.en: Couple of outrageous forehands up the line from Daniil Medvedev.
foreground_english.zh: 梅德韦杰夫连续打出两记惊人的正手直线。

foreground_english.en: This time the pressure does tell.
foreground_english.zh: 这一次，压力终于起了作用。

foreground_english.en: It's been coming.
foreground_english.zh: 此前就已经有这个苗头了。

foreground_english.en: Oh well, that could have been pretty nasty.
foreground_english.zh: 噢，刚才那一下可能会相当危险。

foreground_english.en: But what a response from Novak Djokovic.
foreground_english.zh: 但诺瓦克·德约科维奇的回应太精彩了。

foreground_english.en: It's just brilliant from Medvedev.
foreground_english.zh: 梅德韦杰夫这一球太精彩了。

foreground_english.en: Just bided his time there.
foreground_english.zh: 他一直耐心等待出手机会。

foreground_english.en: A ridiculously physical opening set of tennis.
foreground_english.zh: 首盘的体能消耗大得惊人。

foreground_english.en: Oh, just out of his reach.
foreground_english.zh: 噢，刚好超出了他的触球范围。

foreground_english.en: And Djokovic continues to play the big point so well today.
foreground_english.zh: 而德约科维奇今天在关键分上继续打得非常出色。

foreground_english.en: That's brilliant from both again.
foreground_english.zh: 两人又共同打出了一段精彩对抗。

foreground_english.en: One of the few players that would actually prefer that drive volley on his backhand wing.
foreground_english.zh: 他是少数更喜欢用反手打这种抽击截击的球员之一。

foreground_english.en: Yeah! Yeah! Yeah! Yeah! Yeah! Yeah!
foreground_english.zh: 呀！呀！呀！呀！呀！呀！

foreground_english.en: That's just amazing depth.
foreground_english.zh: 这球的落点深度真是惊人。

foreground_english.en: The shot beforehand from Djokovic.
foreground_english.zh: 说的是德约科维奇前一拍的击球。

foreground_english.en: But this time he does find a way through.
foreground_english.zh: 但这一次，他终于找到了突破口。

foreground_english.en: Oh, he just went straight back at him.
foreground_english.zh: 噢，他直接朝对手打了回去。

foreground_english.en: Djokovic collapses to the ground in a heap.
foreground_english.zh: 德约科维奇一下倒在了地上。

foreground_english.en: Oh, it's magnificent from Medvedev.
foreground_english.zh: 噢，梅德韦杰夫这一球太精彩了。

foreground_english.en: Can you believe it?
foreground_english.zh: 你能相信吗？

foreground_english.en: Just a flurry of errors from Medvedev.
foreground_english.zh: 梅德韦杰夫突然连续出现失误。

foreground_english.en: That's a brilliant combination from Djokovic.
foreground_english.zh: 德约科维奇这一组击球组合太精彩了。

foreground_english.en: Well, can you believe it?
foreground_english.zh: 这结局，你能相信吗？

foreground_english.en: After the most extraordinary level in this match, it has ended on a Medvedev default.
foreground_english.zh: 这场比赛打出了极其非凡的水准，却以梅德韦杰夫被判失格结束。

foreground_english.en: Well, no real protest from Daniil Medvedev, but it's hard to argue with the decision from Mohamed Lahyani and the the ATP supervisor there.
foreground_english.zh: 梅德韦杰夫并没有真正提出抗议；很难反驳拉希亚尼和现场ATP监督作出的判罚。

method_details: Extracted full AV1 source to signed 16-bit 16kHz mono WAV using ffmpeg.

faster-whisper small.en full-source VAD and no-VAD local windows; medium.en independent no-VAD local windows; separate medium.en VAD checks of narration and ASR noise gaps. Raw word timestamps and probabilities retained.

Source captions are automatic, so player and chair name aliases corrected deterministically; non-name wording follows source captions except the first 24-second line, independently recovered clearly by medium.en.

Word timing has limited resolution; sentence bounds include conservative padding and reflect source-absolute seconds. Some first-word ASR bounds start at a local-window edge and are rejected in favor of aligned supporting runs.

234–245 contains nonlexical court vocalizations. Source captions render three as yeah; both independent no-VAD models render six Yeah tokens. Their six lexical shout candidates are retained conservatively in one contiguous bilingual cue, covering the union of medium and small time extents. Ahh-only candidates are classified as nonlexical grunts. The note does not claim exact acoustic utterance counting by a listener.

No-VAD small generates repeated noise phrases in non-commentary gaps. At 149–161, 180–190, 339.22–343.8 and 273–309, source captions are empty and medium VAD returns zero detected speech; these noise-only hypotheses are explicitly not adopted as original words. At 76.58–87, medium VAD returns only Ugh, a nonlexical exertion sound.
